description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git ls-tree' command within a Git project. It sets up a directory structure with files, symlinks, and subdirectories, then runs various 'git ls-tree' commands with different options and path filters to verify the correctness of tree listing functionality.

methods.name: test_output
methods.description: Defines a function to process the current output, replacing object IDs with a placeholder for comparison.
